scenes.title: Bends
scenes.subtitle: Make notes sing.
lines: This lesson teaches how to make notes sing using bends.
Practice slowly, and let the sound guide you.

scenes.heading: Bending strings
lines: Bending strings gives guitar playing emotion.
Push the string toward the ceiling with finger 3, while fingers 1 and 2 hold it steady.
Bend until the pitch matches the target — a whole-step bend raises the sound by two frets.
With practice, your bends will feel smooth and expressive.
Add vibrato to make every note sing.

scenes.title: Hit the target
lines: Play string 3 at fret 9 to set the target pitch.
Then bend string 3 at fret 7 up until it matches.
Play a bend, and the app will listen through the microphone.
